name: ECOFIRS
recent: EcoFirst 近期出现执行主席 Chew Hian Tat 一连串股权交易申报，同时公司正进行 RM70 million 集资，并获准延至 11 月 30 日完成 RM45 million 槟城土地收购。最新季度营收环比大增但同比下滑。
notable: 执行主席 Chew Hian Tat 在 11 月多次申报买卖公司股份。
公司进行 RM70 million 集资。
公司获延至 11 月 30 日完成 RM45 million 槟城土地收购。
risks: 执行主席 Chew Hian Tat 在多个交易日有出售股份的申报。
公司进行 RM70 million 集资，可能涉及新股发行。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日季度，营收 RM78.659 million，环比增 92.8%，同比减 50.7%；净利 RM1.831 million，环比增 277.5%，同比减 86.9%；净利率 2.3%。

events.what: 下一季 (11 月底结束) 季报最迟公布日 · 交易所规定
events.what_en: Deadline for the quarter ending Nov (Bursa rule)

recent_en: EcoFirst has seen a series of shareholding transaction filings by Executive Chairman Chew Hian Tat, while the company is undertaking a RM70 million fundraise and has been given until Nov 30 to complete RM45 million Penang land purchases. Latest quarter revenue rose sharply QoQ but fell YoY.
notable_en: Executive Chairman Chew Hian Tat filed multiple dealings in company shares in November.
The company is undertaking a RM70 million fundraise.
The company was given until Nov 30 to complete RM45 million Penang land purchases.
risks_en: Executive Chairman Chew Hian Tat reported share disposals on several trading days.
The company is undertaking a RM70 million fundraise, which may involve new share issuance.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 Aug 2026, revenue was RM78.659 million, up 92.8% QoQ but down 50.7% YoY; net income was RM1.831 million, up 277.5% QoQ but down 86.9% YoY; net margin was 2.3%.
